sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: document requirements, teens behind the wheel and other BMV services
Knowledge facts: part C holds 31 fact blocks (sec10-F01 onward) from physical pages 73 to 78; part C2 holds 20 confusable and continuation blocks (sec10-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the back-cover publication line, the two-component structure and the 80 percent per-component passing standard from physical pages 1, 10, 68 and 84; the question count and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- IN-DOCS-A-COUNT — knowledge-exam question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- IN-DOCS-A-TIME — knowledge-exam time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- IN-DOCS-D-TEENPAX — teen crash-doubling statistic printed without a source (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- IN-DOCS-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- IN-DOCS-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the acceptable document lists, the BMV phone line, REALID.IN.gov guidance, payment methods, delivery times and kiosk transactions (for example sec10-F31, sec10-R20) can change and must be refreshed from IN.gov/BMV.

corpus_stability.reason: The Indiana Driver's Manual back cover reads Published July 2026 and tells readers to check IN.gov/BMV for updates; the BMV manual page says printed manuals are updated at most once a year, so the selected pages are treated as stable within a year while fees and service details stay dynamic.
